_readme: fp16 patch table for Kaggle T4 x2 (Turing / SM75 -- no bf16 in hardware).
Krea 2 ships bf16 weights and Wan2GP assumes bf16 in several loaders. On a T4
every bf16 tensor has to become fp16 before it reaches a kernel, or you get a
dtype-mismatch crash (most often when a reference image first hits the vision
tower, because that load path has no preprocess_sd of its own).
These patches are scoped to the krea2 model files. Replacing torch.bfloat16
with torch.float16 inside them is safe here specifically because this GPU can
never use bf16 at all -- there is no case where the original was correct.
IMPORTANT -- verify, then harden:
1. Run:  python scripts/krea_server.py --probe
It prints [matches] / [already applied] / [!! NO MATCH] per entry.
2. Anything that says NO MATCH means upstream drifted. Open the file and
fix the find string against your pinned WAN2GP_COMMIT.
3. Once a patch matches on your pinned SHA, flip its "required" to true.
After that, drift becomes a hard boot failure instead of a silent no-op.
They ship with required=false so a first boot still comes up: krea_server.py's
post-load force_fp16_inplace() sweep catches whatever the patches miss. The
sweep is correct but slower, and its 'converted' count in the log tells you
how much the patches failed to cover.
count -1 = replace every occurrence in that file.

patches.name: krea2_main bf16 -> fp16
patches.why: Main pipeline dtype: transformer, latents, and the noisy-token path.

patches.name: krea2_handler bf16 -> fp16 (text encoder + vision tower)
patches.why: Loads Qwen3-VL. The vision tower load has no preprocess_sd, so without this it stays bf16 and the first reference image crashes on dtype mismatch.

patches.name: qwen text encoder bf16 -> fp16
patches.why: Krea 2's text encoder is Qwen3-VL-4B and reuses the shared qwen loader. This is the patch that had already stopped matching in the original notebook.

patches.name: qwen VAE bf16 -> fp16
patches.why: VAE decode runs after every generation; a bf16 VAE on Turing falls back to a slow emulated path or NaNs out.
